messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Kannada, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Kannada line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Kannada translation from Step 2)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Kannada) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|--------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | **mosse** | “first hour / moment” | **ಮೊದಲ ಗಂಟೆ** | “first hour” | OK | | **di** (line 40) | genitive marker “of” | **ಸಮಯದ** | “of time” | OK | | **prima** | “first / earliest” | **ಮೊದಲ** | “first” | OK | | **quelle** | demonstrative “those” | *(omitted)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | **cose** | “things” (rendered as “sweet season”) | **ಋತು** | “season” | OK | | **belle** | “beautiful / sweet” | **ಮಧುರ** | “sweet” | OK | | **sì** | resultative “so … that” | **ಅದರಿಂದ** | “by that / because of that” | **WRONG** (renders a causal relation) | | **ch'a** | subordinating conjunction “that” (part of the resultative clause) | *(omitted – merged with “sì”) * | – | UNNECESSARY | | **bene** | “good” (modifying hope) | **ಉತ್ತಮ** | “good” | OK | | **sperar** | infinitive “to hope” | **ಆಶೆ** | “hope” | OK | | **m'era** | “to me was” (experiencer) | **ನನಗೆ** | “to me” | OK | | **cagione** | “occasion / cause” | **ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿತ್ತು** | “was the cause” | OK | | **di** (line 42) | genitive marker “of” | *(omitted)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | **quella** | demonstrative “that” | **ಆ** | “that” | OK | | **fiera** | “wild beast” | **ಕಾಡು ಪ್ರಾಣಿ** | “wild beast” | OK | | **a** (preposition “with”) | marks attribute “with” | *(omitted – expressed by the genitive “ಚರ್ಮದ”) * | – | UNNECESSARY | | **la** | article “the” (feminine) | *(omitted)* | – | UNNECESSARY | | **gaetta** | “dappled / speckled” | **ಮಡಚು** | “dappled” | OK | | **pelle** | “skin” | **ಚರ್ಮ** | “skin” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention
- **WRONG:** **sì** – rendered as **ಅದರಿಂದ**, which conveys a causal meaning (“because of that”) rather than the required resultative “so … that”. - **UNNECESSARY:** **quelle**, **ch'a**, **di** (line 42), **a**, **la** – these function words or demonstratives are naturally omitted in Kannada and do not need explicit equivalents.
No **MISSING** or **GRAMMAR** errors were detected; all required content is present and agreement is appropriate.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Kannada script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Kannada text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 40: - Original: ಸಮಯದ ಮೊದಲ ಗಂಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಧುರ ಋತು; - Issue: none - Corrected: ಸಮಯದ ಮೊದಲ ಗಂಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಧುರ ಋತು;
- Line 41: - Original: ಅದರಿಂದ ನನಗೆ ಉತ್ತಮ ಆಶೆಯ ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿತ್ತು - Issue: WRONG (causal “ಅದರಿಂದ” instead of resultative) - Corrected: ಅಷ್ಟು ಆಗಿ ನನಗೆ ಉತ್ತಮ ಆಶೆಯ ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿತ್ತು
- Line 42: - Original: ಆ ಕಾಡು ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯ ಮಡಚು ಚರ್ಮದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ. - Issue: UNNECESSARY punctuation (period not in source) - Corrected: ಆ ಕಾಡು ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯ ಮಡಚು ಚರ್ಮದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ
``` ಸಮಯದ ಮೊದಲ ಗಂಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮಧುರ ಋತು; ಅಷ್ಟು ಆಗಿ ನನಗೆ ಉತ್ತಮ ಆಶೆಯ ಕಾರಣವಾಗಿತ್ತು ಆ ಕಾಡು ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯ ಮಡಚು ಚರ್ಮದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ```
